nodes.name: Call Extraction Service
nodes.notes: Same extraction-service /extract endpoint as email_intake.json -- only the trigger and the raw_content assembly differ, which is exactly the 'small diff' the spec calls for when the service boundary in Phase 1 is clean. Telegram's own first_name is prepended since chat messages don't always restate the sender's name the way emails/texts tend to; the LLM still treats the whole string as message content to extract from, not as ground truth to trust blindly. URL is localhost:8000 because this project runs n8n and extraction-service both natively, not in Docker (see LOGS.md) -- if you're on the docker-compose.yml path instead, change this to http://extraction-service:8000/extract (the Docker network hostname).
